title: Kenyan Sausage Skewers
description: A flavorful and colorful dish featuring Kenyan sausages, perfect for a summer barbecue or outdoor gathering.

ingredients.name: Vegetables of your choice (e.g., onions, bell peppers, tomatoes, mushrooms)
Skewers (wooden or metal)
ingredients.notes: Soaked in water for at least 30 minutes before use

instructions: Soak wooden skewers in water for at least 30 minutes before grilling.
Lightly brown the Kenyan sausages by grilling them for 2-3 minutes per side.
Thread the vegetables and sausages onto the skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with a little oil and season with salt, pepper, and chili flakes (if using).
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the sausages are cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Serve hot with lemon wedges on the side (if using).
Let the skewers rest for 2-3 minutes before serving.
